The bird is in non-breeding or female plumage, characterized by a speckled brownish-grey head and back, with distinct orange-rufous patches on the breast and flanks. It has a conical, two-toned bill (grey base, yellow tip) and pinkish legs. The background is a soft-focus mix of earth tones.
